NAME:
   sdd new - Create a new graph entry

USAGE:
   sdd new [options] <type> <layer> [description]

OPTIONS:
   --refs string [ --refs string ]                Reference (repeatable) — JSON object {"id":"<id>","kind":"<kind>","desc":"<optional>"}. Kind is one of: grounded-in, builds-on, refines, addresses, surfaces, surfaced-by, depends-on, required-by, related.
   --supersedes string                            Comma-separated list of entry IDs this supersedes
   --closes string                                Comma-separated list of entry IDs this closes/resolves
   --participants string                          Comma-separated list of participants
   --confidence string                            Confidence level (high, medium, low)
   --intent string                                Directive lifecycle posture (pending, guiding, settled) — required on directives, rejected on other kinds
   --kind string                                  Entry kind: signals — gap (default), fact, question, insight, done, actor, annotation; decisions — directive (default), activity, plan, contract, aspiration, role, focus, procedure
   --canonical string                             Canonical identity name (kind: actor and kind: procedure) — written into frontmatter
   --class string                                 Procedure execution role (kind: procedure only): move (default) or shell — shells are session bases auto-started by the session door
   --aliases string                               Comma-separated aliases (kind: actor only) — read-side convenience for mining and comprehension
   --actor-kind string                            What sort of participant this is (kind: actor only): human or machine — omitted means unknown, never human
   --actor string                                 Canonical name the role binds to (kind: role only) — must match an active actor chain's head canonical
   --topics topics:                               Comma-separated topic labels (any kind) — inline topic membership written as topics: strings
   --index string                                 Fact retrieval cue — JSON object {"title":"<standalone title>","topic":"<topic also in --topics>"}
   --topic string [ --topic string ]              Topic cluster (kind: annotation only) — JSON object {"label":"path","members":["id",...]}; repeatable. A plain string in --topics works too for whole-refs membership.
   --actors string                                Comma-separated focus-level default actor canonicals (kind: focus only)
   --when string                                  Focus-level default temporal scope (kind: focus only) — JSON object {"from":"YYYY-MM-DD","to":"YYYY-MM-DD"}; at least one of from/to required
   --involvement string [ --involvement string ]  Involvement triple (kind: focus only) — JSON object {"target":"<id>","actors":["..."],"when":{"from":"...","to":"..."}}; repeatable. actors omitted inherits focus default; explicit "actors":[] means pull-available.
   --attach string [ --attach string ]            File to attach (repeatable). Supports source:target mapping and -:name for stdin
   --skip-preflight                               Skip pre-flight validation (entry is annotated with preflight: skipped)
   --preflight-verified                           Skip pre-flight validation, annotating the entry preflight: dry-run-verified — for a capture whose findings were already settled via --dry-run
   --summary string                               Store this summary verbatim, skipping LLM summary generation
   --title string                                 Store this title verbatim instead of the generated one
   --dry-run                                      Run validation and pre-flight only, without writing or committing the entry
   --provider string                              LLM provider (claude-cli, anthropic, openai, ollama) — overrides config
   --model string                                 LLM model identifier — overrides config
   --preflight-model string                       Legacy alias for --model in the pre-flight context
   --preflight-timeout duration                   Timeout for pre-flight validation (e.g. 120s, 2m) (default: 2m0s)
   --preflight-extract-timeout duration           Timeout for the extraction call a pre-flight response falls back to (e.g. 60s) (default: 1m0s)
   --help, -h                                     show help

GLOBAL OPTIONS:
   --version                      Print the version
   --graph-dir string, -d string  Override graph directory (auto-discovered from .sdd/config.yaml)
   --local-config string          Use this file as the machine-local config layer instead of .sdd/config.local.yaml (read and written)
   --verbose, -v                  Enable info-level logging
   --extra-verbose, --vv          Enable debug-level logging
   --timing                       Print how long each phase of the command takes to stderr [$SDD_TIMING]
